title: baccharis incarum
intro: Baccharis incarum, commonly known as the Bolivian tree cinchona, is a species of flowering plant in the dill family (Apiaceae). This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its ability to lower fever and alleviate symptoms of colds and flu, attributed to its health benefits in treating respiratory issues and as an antipyretic agent. The therapeutic actions of Baccharis incarum include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for various infections and conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
